units.source_text: ……这时候，我的确产生了一种自觉：

en.t: ... At that moment, I truly came to a certain awareness:

units.source_text: 我向黑暗的世界张开双臂等待着；

en.t: I was waiting with both arms spread wide toward the dark world;

units.source_text: 不久，5月的花、制服、坏心眼的同学们都将投入我张开的双臂里；

en.t: before long, the flowers of May, the uniforms, and my spiteful classmates would all throw themselves into my outstretched arms;

units.source_text: 我自己要在社会底层紧紧拉住、抓住这个世界……

en.t: I myself would, from the bottom of society, hold fast to this world and seize it...

units.source_text: 然而，这种自觉成为少年的自豪，

en.t: Yet for this awareness to become a boy's pride
was surely too heavy a burden.
